Summary: Password with exactly 8 characters is rejected
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Minor

Open Register and enter valid details with password Abcd@123 (8 characters, including upper case, lower case, a digit and a special character).

Expected: account created. Minimum length is 8.
Actual: 400 WEAK_PASSWORD. A 9 character password works; 7 is rejected correctly.

Test case: TC-REG-07

Summary: Same email in a different case registers a second account
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Major

meera@example.com already exists. Register Meera@Example.com with otherwise valid details.

This should return 409 EMAIL_EXISTS. It returns 201 and creates another account. Q4 shows meera@example.com with accounts = 2. The new account's password does not work at login.

Test cases: TC-REG-12, TC-DB-04

Summary: Search only matches when the case is the same
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Major

Search for SHOES: expected Running Shoes, actual "No products found".
Search for pack: expected Laptop Backpack and Notebook Pack of 5, actual only Laptop Backpack.

Search should ignore upper/lower case.

Test cases: TC-SRC-03, TC-SRC-04

Summary: Searching for % or _ returns every product
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Minor

Search for %, then for _. Both return all 12 products. Expected no results because neither character is in a product name.

The search text is used in a LIKE pattern without escaping the wildcard characters.

Test case: TC-SRC-07

Summary: More than the stock can be bought, stock goes negative
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Major

Start each check from reset data:
1. Add 1 Smart Watch (stock 3), then update quantity to 5. Expected 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK; update is accepted.
2. Meera and Arjun each add 3 Smart Watches. Meera orders first, then Arjun. Arjun's order should be refused, but both succeed and stock reaches -3.

The orders are sequential. This is not a concurrency test.

Test cases: TC-CRT-10, TC-CHK-14, TC-DB-02

Summary: Shipping charged on a cart of exactly 500.00
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Minor

Add 1 Steel Water Bottle, priced at 500.00, and check the cart totals.

Expected shipping 0.00 and total 500.00. Actual shipping 49.00 and total 549.00. Free shipping should start at exactly 500.00.

Test case: TC-CRT-14

Summary: Coupon discount is not capped at 150.00
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Major

Add Running Shoes (2499.00) and apply WELCOME10.

Discount should stop at 150.00, giving a total of 2349.00. The cart takes off 249.90 instead and shows total 2249.10.

Test case: TC-CPN-02

Build 1.0, severity Minor

At checkout, use pincode 5000011 with a product in the cart and valid values in the other fields.

Expected a pincode error. The order is placed with the 7 digit pincode.

Test case: TC-CHK-07

Summary: My orders shows the total without shipping
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Major

Order 1 Ceramic Coffee Mug (199.00 plus 49.00 shipping). Confirmation shows 248.00. Open My orders: it shows 199.00 instead of 248.00.

Order details and the database both have the correct total, 248.00. Only the list leaves out shipping.

Test cases: TC-ORD-01, TC-ORD-07, TC-DB-06

Summary: Any logged in user can open someone else's order
Description:
Build 1.0, severity Critical

Meera places an order. Note the number, then request GET /api/orders/{order number} using Arjun's login token.

Expected: 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND.
Actual: 200 with Meera's items, name, address and phone number.
